title: I Love You, Man
tagline: Rush on the stereo. Snacks on the couch.
about: A friendless groom-to-be goes on a series of man-dates to find a best man and meets the one guy who gets him.
cue: Serve the snacks when Peter and Sydney head to the gig.

    StartersVenice Beach crispy fish tacosBeer-battered fish, slaw, pickled onion and chipotle mayo in tortillasHow to make it500g firm white fish fillets1 red onion3 limes1/4 cabbage, shredded120g mayonnaise1 tin chipotle in adobo120g plain flour1 tsp baking powder1 can lager2 L vegetable oil8 small flour tortillas1 bunch corianderSlice the red onion thin and soak in lime juice and salt for 20 minutes.Toss a quarter of a shredded cabbage with lime and salt.Mix the mayonnaise with the chipotle in adobo.Whisk the flour, the baking powder and the cold lager.Heat the oil, cut the white fish into strips, dip in the batter and fry at 180°C for 3 minutes.Warm the tortillas and fill with slaw, fish, onion, mayo and coriander.Man cave pulled pork nachosCorn chips with pulled pork, black beans, cheddar and lime sour creamHow to make it400g pulled pork3 tbsp barbecue sauce300g corn chips400g tin black beans200g cheddar150g sour cream1 lime1 jar pickled jalapeños2 tomatoes1 bunch coriander2 spring onionsToss the pulled pork with the barbecue sauce.Spread the corn chips on a big tray and scatter with the pork, the drained black beans and the grated cheddar.Bake at 200°C for 10 minutes until melted.Mix the sour cream with the juice of the lime and drizzle over.Top with sliced pickled jalapeños, diced tomato, coriander and spring onion.MainsOpen house roast beef baguettesRare roast beef, rocket, pickled onion and horseradish cream in a baguetteHow to make it1 red onion80ml red wine vinegar1 tsp sugar100g sour cream2 tbsp horseradish2 baguettes400g rare roast beef1 bag rocket2 tbsp fried shallotsSlice the red onion thin and soak in the red wine vinegar with the sugar for 20 minutes.Mix the sour cream with the horseradish and salt.Split the baguettes lengthways, spread with the horseradish cream and layer with the sliced rare roast beef, a handful of rocket, the drained onion and the fried shallots.Press down and cut each into pieces.SweetsPeter and Zooey's cream cheese300g icing sugar12 cupcake casesHeat the oven to 175°C.Beat the butter and the caster sugar with the zest of the lemons, add the eggs, then the self-raising flour and the milk.Bake in the cases for 18 minutes and cool.Cut a small hole in each and fill with lemon curd.Beat the cream cheese with the soft butter and the icing sugar, pipe on top and finish with lemon zest.DrinksSydney's
